question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Would you get in a fight to improve your reputation?
options: Fighting can never improve your rep.

question_options.question: Who do you like better, Colt or Kenji?

nodes.text: Colt gets back on his motorcycle and rides off.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't get it. All the girls are crazy for that guy.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: He's exactly like me except... `He's` a complete jerk.
nodes.text_bbcode: He's exactly like me except... [color=#e23b3b][i]He's[/i][/color] a complete jerk.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Are you blind, Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Spike, you `have` to talk to him. If I do, I know I'll just say something mean about how stupid he is.
nodes.text_bbcode: Spike, you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to talk to him. If I do, I know I'll just say something mean about how stupid he is.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Would you guys tell me what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You are `not` like Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] like Colt.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Not anymore, anyway.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You care about grades, your motorcycle's a dust farm, and you back down from challenges at the first sign of trouble...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Plus, you drink iced caramel macchiatos...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha! So many syllables for a drink!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You've gotten soft, Kenji. Ever since Linda...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: She's got nothing to do with this!
Three months earlier...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you excited for Wacky Wildlife?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: A little.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This episode's all about baby polar bears!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's my phone.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kenji! We are about to do the craziest thing, man!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Megan lost a bet... Now she has to race her Anaconda backwards at Skyway!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We're going to be there in `twenty` minutes. See you there?
nodes.text_bbcode: We're going to be there in [color=#e23b3b][i]twenty[/i][/color] minutes. See you there?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... I can't go.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Maybe you didn't hear me...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Megan's Anaconda. Skyway Racetrack. `Backwards!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Megan's Anaconda. Skyway Racetrack. [color=#e23b3b][i]Backwards![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's starting!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I... I can't make it, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, I get it.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Say 'hi' to Linda for me.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Maybe Linda `did` have something to do with it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe Linda [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] have something to do with it...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: She's gone, buddy. It's time to remember who you are.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Colt thinks he can come here, act tough, and walk all over everyone.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Walk all over `you`, dude.
nodes.text_bbcode: Walk all over [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color], dude.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What would the old Kenji do?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sleep on it...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's the challenge?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All you have to do is tell me what's wrong with my bike.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's not hard...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: In one minute.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: One minute?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That's impossible!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: It isn't. I can do it.
After a minute...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Time's up.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I can't find anything wrong with your bike...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's because there isn't anything wrong with it, Softie.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You can tell a tough guy by the condition of his motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I'd bet my life `your` bike is that rusty cobweb factory in the corner.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'd bet my life [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] bike is that rusty cobweb factory in the corner.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There some kind of problem?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, you.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Easy now, fellas.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not backing down.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Neither am I.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Instead of smelling your coffee breath for the next hour, why don't we settle this properly?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A race.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Name the time and place.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Skyway racetrack. Tonight. Midnight.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Midnight! But it's a school night!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Real tough there, Bookworm.
A crowd forms around the new guy...
The rebels watch from a distance...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Love your bike!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: What an entrance!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's your name?
He takes off his helmet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Colt.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't understand what she's... What they're fawning over...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I mean, I've got a motorcycle, too.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Are you going to talk to him, Spike?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, I think it's time.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kenji... about how you've been acting lately...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Can we do this in Auto-Shop later? I've got a math quiz.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: ...Sure.
The crowd around Colt breaks up for class.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I can't believe he's here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know that guy, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... I'll meet you in class, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, see you there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, what are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, babe, didn't expect to see you so soon.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I wasn't exactly expecting to see you, either.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got out of boot camp.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Doesn't look like it's changed you much.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why change a good thing?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Still the same overconfident...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm going out for a ride tonight. You want to come along?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt... Things are different here. `I'm` different here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt... Things are different here. [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] different here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not going to let you ruin my life again!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Relax. I get it. You need some space...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just... Do me a favor and leave me alone!
Sam storms off.
Later that day...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Has anyone heard anything about this new guy?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I heard he's the one who pulled the fire alarm on the school assembly this morning...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I heard he's been to boot camp so many times they call him The Shoemaker.
Just then, Colt rides into the Auto-Shop on his motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What do `you` want?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] want?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thought I'd offer you a challenge.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Pass.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've been asking around... Every kid I've talked to says you were some kind of a tough guy once.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't think there's ever been a tough guy at this powder puff school, so I had to see for myself.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So far, you haven't changed my mind...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It totally is.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm surprised. I thought you'd be upset or something.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Because, man... That guy used to be you.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Used to?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Who cares?! What's the worst they're going to do him? Tell him to move it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: He could get suspended.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: For parking on grass?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What's happened to you, man?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Nothing. Forget it.
Kenji tries to duck, but the punch lands square on his cheek.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oooww!
The other guys jump into the fray!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hope you know how to fight.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I fight better than I race.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's reassuring.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Here's how this works...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You give us our wallets back.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: We rough you up.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Or...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You don't give us our wallets back.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: And we beat you to a pulp.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Why don't you go back inside and grab a few more goons?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That way you'll have a chance...
The college guys surround Kenji and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's Kenji, right?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Colt.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I know.
Kenji watches over his shoulder as he runs for the alley entrance...
He sees Colt hopping, trying to shake James... Then, Colt falls!
John and Dontae bang out of the pool hall and seize Colt.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Weren't there four of them?
Kenji runs smack into Bryce at the alley entrance!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Going somewhere?
Bryce grabs Kenji and hauls him back into the alley.
Kenji pries James's fingers from Colt's leg just as John and Dontae bang out of the pool hall!
Colt scrambles to his feet and they bolt for the alley entrance!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Weren't there four of them?
Just then, Bryce appears at the alley entrance, cutting them off!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Going somewhere, ladies?
The game continues with Colt missing most of his shots, and Kenji trying to catch up...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: This is it, losers. 8-ball, corner pocket...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: And that's the game!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess the table is yours, gentlemen.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Adios, suckers.
Kenji and Colt move to another table...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What are you so happy about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing. Let's get our game in quick.
Colt breaks, pocketing a stripe.
Then he sinks another ball...
And another!
And another!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't understand! Why'd you lose to those guys?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All a part of the hustle...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: When you hustle, aren't you supposed to leave the table `with their money!`
nodes.text_bbcode: When you hustle, aren't you supposed to leave the table [color=#e23b3b][i]with their money![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I got their money.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I'm about to get yours...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 8-ball, side pocket...
He sinks it easy.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What? How'd you get `their` money?
nodes.text_bbcode: What? How'd you get [color=#e23b3b][i]their[/i][/color] money?

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey! Where's my wallet?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Um... I'll tell you how on the way outta here!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, my wallet's gone, too!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Mine, too!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How fast are you?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You pickpocketed them!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: They took our wallets!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Get 'em!
Kenji and Colt sprint for the exit, the college guys chasing after them!
They crash through a side door and into an alleyway.
James dives and snags Colt's leg!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Son of a...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good shot.

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: At least one of you can play...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Too bad it's not going to be enough.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Wow, you guys are terrible.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You're not trying to hustle us, are you?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: No, I think they genuinely stink.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Maybe we should let them have the table so they can practice.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I guess Colt really wants me to make shots if I have them...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're going to take these guys for all they're worth. Don't screw it up.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What do you want me to do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just play how you normally would... I'll do the rest.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Hey, you two playing or what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Waiting on you. We'll even let you break...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Go for it, Dontae.
Dontae pounds the cue ball, knocking in two solids!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Ha! This game's easy.
He misses the next shot.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Crap.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My turn.
Colt lines up his shot...
And scratches! As he hands Kenji the cue stick, he winks.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Looks like this is going to be even easier than I thought...
James shoots...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Awww... I barely missed.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: My turn... I have an easy shot on the twelve, or I could flub my shot and scratch the way Colt did...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tell you what, we'll play you for it.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You're on.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't see a sign anywhere saying this is yours.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: We've been at this table all night.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And yet, somehow, we ended up playing on it.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You little...

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Easy, Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's it look like? Playing pool.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Not anymore you're not.
Bryce sweeps his hand across the table, knocking the balls every which way!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You're gonna pay for that!

nodes.speaker: John
nodes.text: Hey, easy fellas.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: This isn't over!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Colt wins!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Watching that race gave me bruises...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Watching Colt gave me goosebumps...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: He's like a living dream... Sigh...
He barrels forward, the final push across the finish line a blur of metal and speed.
Kenji swerves at the last second, narrowly avoiding the tire!
Kenji slams into the tire!
He flies toward the finish line!
Suddenly, Colt charges up behind him.
They're neck-and-neck!
But something's in the middle of the road!
It's an old tire!
Kenji goes easy on the brake...
Just when it seems like he's going to tip over...
The turn ends, and he surges ahead, Colt behind him!
Kenji squeezes the brake as hard as he can. His tires screech through the turn!
They catch, and he goes flying off the track!
By the time he recovers, he's completely lost sight of Colt!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Maybe he wiped out, too...
Here it is...
Wipe Out Turn!
He hesitates...
Colt cuts his bike in front of him, closing off the gap!
He pushes hard on Colt's right...
For a moment, the two are side-by-side...
Then Kenji pulls ahead!
Kenji has the opportunity to pass Colt on the right!
Kenji isn't going to make the turn!
He veers off the track, his tires rattling against the uneven dirt.
But Colt misses the turn, too!
Kenji steers back onto the track at the same time as Colt!
Kenji leans into the turn, his knee barely grazing the asphalt...
Colt takes the turn too sharply!
The track's first turn looms ahead...
Kenji blasts forward!
Colt quickly holds the inside lane...
Kenji stalls!
Colt rockets ahead!
After a few precious seconds, Kenji rumbles forward.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Keep dreaming...
Taylor raises her arms over her head...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: On your mark...
Their motors come to life...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Go Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You can do it, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You got this, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Get set...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wait! Wait!
Spike runs over to Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is it?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I forgot to tell you, Kenji... The last turn of the course is called Wipe Out Turn!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I know that! You're making me lose focus!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You don't understand! When we came here with Megan that night, we learned that to avoid wiping out, you have hit the brakes `soft`. Hit 'em hard and you... Well, you'll be a commercial for gauze.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't understand! When we came here with Megan that night, we learned that to avoid wiping out, you have hit the brakes [color=#e23b3b][i]soft[/i][/color]. Hit 'em hard and you... Well, you'll be a commercial for gauze.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Thanks, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Lovebirds... Can we get on with the race? My arms are getting tired...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm ready!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: On your mark...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Again.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh whatever. Just go.
Taylor lowers her arms!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Name the time.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And if I say, 'Tonight. Midnight'?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'll see you then.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Gasp! I have to tell...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `...Everyone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...Everyone![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Midnight...
A crowd of students, many of them cheerleaders, has formed at the starting line of the Skyway Racetrack.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I wonder if she's here for me... Or for him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's do this.
Kenji and Colt coast their motorcycles to the starting line...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You need a hot chick!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: He's right, unfortunately.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: A hot chick at the starting line sanctifies any motorcycle race.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll do it!
Taylor jogs out in front of the two bikes...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, I want to say thanks to everyone for coming out today!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This isn't a pep rally, blondie. Cut to the meat.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatev.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm going to raise my arms above my head.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: When I drop them, the race is on!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That'd be a good bet...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If it were friendly...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But you've been on my case from the second I got here...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I want you to suffer.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Loser has to pay the winner...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 200 bucks!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Um... You're on.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're on.

options.label: Wash and wax the winner's bike.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: I don't know what you're trying to do, Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: It seems like you're two different people.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's like Kenji doesn't know who he is anymore...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, it's almost like he doesn't exist.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm sick of everyone here thinking you're some kind of legend.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you want me to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I want you to actually `do` something.
nodes.text_bbcode: I want you to actually [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] something.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Race me at Skyway.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You sure? It's a school night after all...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Are you gonna race or not?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why should I? Other than the joy of seeing you cough on my exhaust smoke.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Because the loser will have to...
After class...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I heard he gave himself his own tattoo!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I heard he got in a fight with Officer Monte... And won!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Linda, what do `you` think of Colt?
nodes.text_bbcode: Linda, what do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] think of Colt?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: He's... Interesting.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Did you hear that, Spike?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, I think I'd have trouble keeping the lines straight if I tattoo'd myself...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No, man, Linda's `into` Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, man, Linda's [color=#e23b3b][i]into[/i][/color] Colt.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So? Every girl's into Colt.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: She used to look that way about me.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I didn't really see any look.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's it. I've got to bring him down a peg.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Like this!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey, new guy!

options.label: Yikes, it's hard to think over all this clatter.
When a word sounds like what it describes.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: What is onomatopoeia?

options.label: He wrote that the report of his death was an exaggeration.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Mark Twain wrote...?
